convert_to_anticipation: convert a pandas DataFrame of video clips to action anticipation format using tau_a and tau_o parameters
dense_clip_sampler: sample dense video clips from a dataset DataFrame at a fixed stride for self-supervised learning or feature extraction
BaseVideoDataset: create a PyTorch video dataset that reads clips from a DataFrame with configurable sampling strategies and transforms
BaseVideoDataset__sample: sample a fixed-size video clip from a video file using random, center, first, or last clip strategies
BaseVideoDataset__class_balance_data_idx: remap a dataset index to achieve class-balanced sampling by redistributing indices across label classes
